Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا مُنْتَهَى مَطْلَبِ الْحَاجَاتِ
Translation: O Allah, O Ultimate Goal of all needs

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ عِنْدَهُ نَيْلُ الطَّلِبَاتِ
Translation: And O One with whom is the fulfillment of all requests

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يَبِيعُ نِعَمَهُ بِالْأَثْمَانِ
Translation: And O One who does not sell His blessings for a price

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُكَدِّرُ عَطَايَاهُ بِالْإِمْتِنَانِ
Translation: And O One who does not spoil His gifts with reproach

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ يُسْتَغْنَى بِهِ وَلَا يُسْتَغْنَى عَنْهُ
Translation: And O One who is sought for sufficiency while He needs none

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ يُرْغَبُ إِلَيْهِ وَلَا يُرْغَبُ عَنْهُ
Translation: And O One who is approached with desire and never avoided

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا تُفْنِيْ خَزَائِنَهُ الْمَسَائِلُ
Translation: And O One whose treasures are not depleted by requests

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا تُبَدِّلُ حِكْمَتَهُ الْوَسَائِلُ
Translation: And O One whose wisdom is not altered by means

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا تَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهُ حَوَائِجُ الْمُحْتَاجِينَ
Translation: And O One from whom the needs of the needy are never cut off

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُعَنِّيهِ دُعَاءُ الدَّاعِينَ
Translation: And O One who is not wearied by the supplications of those who call upon Him

Arabic text: تَمَدَّحْتَ بِالْغَنَاءِ عَنْ خَلْقِكَ وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْغِنَى عَنْهُمْ
Translation: You have praised Yourself for being free of need for Your creation, and You are worthy of being free of need for them

Arabic text: وَنَسَبْتَهُمْ إِلَى الْفَقْرِ وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْفَقْرِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And You have attributed poverty to them, and they are truly poor before You

Arabic text: فَمَنْ حَاوَلَ سَدَّ خَلَّتِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
Translation: So whoever seeks to fulfill his need from You

Arabic text: وَرَامَ صَرْفَ الْفَقْرِ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ بِكَ فَقَدْ طَلَبَ حَاجَتَهُ
Translation: And attempts to remove poverty from himself through You, has sought his need

Arabic text: فِيْ مَظَانِّهَا وَأَتَى طَلِبَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا
Translation: In its proper place and has approached his request from the right direction

Arabic text: وَمَنْ تَوَجَّهَ بِحَاجَتِهِ إِلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ جَعَلَهُ سَبَبَ نُجْحِهَا
Translation: And whoever directs his need to anyone from Your creation or makes them the means for its success

Arabic text: دُونَكَ فَقَدْ تَعَرَّضَ لِلْحِرْمَانِ
Translation: Instead of You, has exposed himself to deprivation

Arabic text: وَاسْتَحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَوْتَ الْإِحْسَانِ
Translation: And deserves to be deprived of Your benevolence

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَلِيْ إِلَيْكَ حَاجَةٌ قَدْ قَصَّرَ عَنْهَا جُهْدِي
Translation: O Allah, I have a need for which my effort has fallen short

Arabic text: وَتَقَطَّعَتْ دُونَهَا حِيَلِي
Translation: And my resources have been cut off from achieving it

Arabic text: وَسَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِيْ رَفْعَهَا إِلَى مَنْ يَرْفَعُ حَوَائِجَهُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: And my soul enticed me to present it to one who presents his own needs to You

Arabic text: وَلَا يَسْتَغْنِيْ فِيْ طَلِبَاتِهِ عَنْكَ
Translation: And who is not independent of You in his requests

Arabic text: وَهِيَ زَلَّةٌ مِنْ زَلَلِ الْخَاطِئِينَ
Translation: And this was a slip among the slips of the erroneous

Arabic text: وَعَثْرَةٌ مِنْ عَثَرَاتِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ
Translation: And a stumble among the stumbles of the sinners

Arabic text: ثُمَّ انْتَبَهْتُ بِتَذْكِيرِكَ لِيْ مِنْ غَفْلَتِي
Translation: Then I awoke from my heedlessness by Your reminder

Arabic text: وَنَهَضْتُ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ مِنْ زَلَّتِي
Translation: And I rose from my slip by Your guidance

Arabic text: وَرَجَعْتُ وَنَكَصْتُ بِتَسْدِيْدِكَ عَنْ عَثْرَتِي
Translation: And I returned and retreated from my stumble through Your direction

Arabic text: وَقُلْتُ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيْ كَيْفَ يَسْأَلُ مُحْتَاجٌ مُحْتَاجًا
Translation: And I said: Glory be to my Lord! How can a needy person ask another needy person?

Arabic text: وَأَنَّى يَرْغَبُ مُعْدِمٌ إِلَى مُعْدِمٍ
Translation: And how can a destitute turn to another destitute?

Arabic text: فَقَصَدْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِيْ بِالرَّغْبَةِ
Translation: So I have aimed toward You, my God, with desire

Arabic text: وَأَوْفَدْتُ عَلَيْكَ رَجَائِيْ بِالثِّقَةِ بِكَ
Translation: And I have directed my hope to You with confidence in You

Arabic text: وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّ كَثِيرَ مَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَسِيرٌ فِيْ وُجْدِكَ
Translation: And I know that much of what I ask You is easy in Your possession

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ خَطِيرَ مَا أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ حَقِيرٌ فِيْ وُسْعِكَ
Translation: And that the significant things I seek from You are insignificant in Your capacity

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ كَرَمَكَ لَا يَضِيقُ عَنْ سُؤَالِ أَحَدٍ
Translation: And that Your generosity is not constricted by anyone's request

Arabic text: وَأَنَّ يَدَكَ بِالْعَطَايَا أَعْلَى مِنْ كُلِّ يَدٍ
Translation: And that Your hand in giving is higher than every hand

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَاحْمِلْنِيْ بِكَرَمِكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and carry me by Your generosity to favor

Arabic text: وَلَا تَحْمِلْنِيْ بِعَدْلِكَ عَلَى الِاسْتِحْقَاقِ
Translation: And do not carry me by Your justice to what I deserve

Arabic text: فَمَا أَنَا بِأَوَّلِ رَاغِبٍ رَغِبَ إِلَيْكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ وَهُوَ يَسْتَحِقُّ الْمَنْعَ
Translation: For I am not the first seeker who turned to You and You gave him while he deserved to be denied

Arabic text: وَلَا بِأَوَّلِ سَائِلٍ سَأَلَكَ فَأَفْضَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَسْتَوْجِبُ الْحِرْمَانَ
Translation: Nor the first asker who asked You and You bestowed upon him while he deserved to be deprived

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَكُنْ لِدُعَائِيْ مُجِيبًا وَمِنْ نِدَائِيْ قَرِيبًا
Translation: And be responsive to my supplication, and near to my call

Arabic text: وَلِتَضَرُّعِيْ رَاحِمًا وَلِصَوْتِيْ سَامِعًا
Translation: And merciful to my entreaty, and listening to my voice

Arabic text: وَلَا تَقْطَعْ رَجَائِيْ عَنْكَ وَلَا تَبُتَّ سَبَبِيْ مِنْكَ
Translation: And do not cut off my hope from You, and do not sever my connection to You

Arabic text: وَلَا تُوَجِّهْنِيْ فِيْ حَاجَتِيْ هَذِهِ وَغَيْرِهَا إِلَى سِوَاكَ
Translation: And do not direct me in this need of mine and others to anyone but You

Arabic text: وَتَوَلَّنِيْ بِنُجْحِ طَلِبَتِيْ وَقَضَاءِ حَاجَتِي
Translation: And take charge of the success of my request and the fulfillment of my need

Arabic text: وَنَيْلِ سُؤْلِيْ قَبْلَ زَوَالِيْ عَنْ مَوْقِفِيْ هَذَا
Translation: And the granting of my plea before I leave this position of mine

Arabic text: بِتَيْسِيرِكَ لِيَ الْعَسِيرَ وَحُسْنِ تَقْدِيرِكَ لِيْ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ الْأُمُورِ
Translation: By making easy for me what is difficult, and by Your good arrangement for me in all matters

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً نَامِيَةً لَا انْقِطَاعَ لِأَبَدِهَا
Translation: And send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, blessings that are everlasting, ever-growing, never ending

Arabic text: وَلَا مُنْتَهَى لِأَمَدِهَا وَاجْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ عَوْنًا لِيْ وَسَبَبًا لِنَجَاحِ طَلِبَتِيْ إِنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ
Translation: And with no limit to their duration, and make that a help for me and a means for the success of my request. Indeed, You are All-Encompassing, Most Generous

Arabic text: وَمِنْ حَاجَتِيْ يَا رَبِّ كَذَا وَكَذَا
Translation: And among my needs, O Lord, is such and such

Arabic text: فَضْلُكَ آنَسَنِيْ وَإِحْسَانُكَ دَلَّنِي
Translation: Your grace has comforted me and Your kindness has guided me

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْ لَا تَرُدَّنِيْ خَائِبًا
Translation: So I ask You by Yourself and by Muhammad and his family, Your blessings upon them, that You do not turn me away disappointed
